statement: Paychex, Inc. implemented enhancements to its Paychex Flex platform in fiscal 2024 to improve client and client employee experiences from hiring and onboarding through employee retention.

Paychex, Inc. focused on cost optimization initiatives during the fourth quarter of fiscal 2024, including reductions to its geographic footprint, reprioritization of certain technology investments, and headcount optimization.
PPG Industries, Inc.'s Architectural coatings - Americas and Asia Pacific organic sales increased a low single-digit percentage compared to the prior-year third quarter.
PPG Industries, Inc.'s Automotive refinish coatings organic sales increased by a double-digit percentage compared to the third quarter 2023.
Visa Inc. accepted 241 million shares of class B-1 common stock in an exchange offer on May 6, 2024.
In exchange for the class B-1 shares, Visa issued approximately 120 million shares of class B-2 common stock and 48 million shares of class C common stock on May 8, 2024.
The class B-1 common shares exchanged were retired and constituted authorized but unissued shares.
Realty Income Corporation deployed $893 million in Europe real estate acquisitions during the three months ended March 31, 2025, representing 65% of total investment volume for the quarter.
Moody's Corporation's SFG revenue increased $24 million in the three months ended March 31, 2025 compared to the same period in 2024.

The 21% increase in SFG revenue reflects growth in both the U.S. and internationally, with U.S. Transaction revenue increasing $19 million primarily due to continued momentum in U.S. CLO refinancing activity and increased issuance activity in CMBS.
Lennox International Inc.'s Building Climate Solutions segment net sales increased 17% for the nine months ended September 30, 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.

The Building Climate Solutions segment's net sales increase was primarily due to higher sales volumes of 8%, favorable price and mix of 3%, and a 6% increase in sales volumes from the AES acquisition.
The Building Climate Solutions segment's profit increased $48 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Refining segment operating income decreased by $2.9 billion in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the third quarter of 2023.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Refining segment adjusted operating income also decreased by $2.9 billion in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the third quarter of 2023.
Assurant, Inc. increased its common stock dividend by 11% in November 2023, raising the quarterly dividend from $0.72 to $0.80 per common share.
Northern Trust Corporation's common equity Tier 1 ratio under the standardized approach remained flat at 12.6% for the period ending September 30, 2024.
The AES Corporation's first quarter net income decreased $351 million from $278 million to a net loss of $73 million compared with the prior year.

The decrease in net income was due to higher prior year revenues from the monetization of the Warrior Run coal plant PPA, one-time costs due to organizational restructuring, and a gain in the prior year on dilution of our interest in Uplight, partially offset by higher contributions from the Utilities and Renewables SBUs.

American Tower Corporation's AFFO attributable to common stockholders increased for the three months ended September 30, 2024, primarily due to an increase in operating profit (excluding straight-line accounting) and decreases in cash paid for income taxes and capital improvement capital expenditures.

The AFFO increase for the nine months ended September 30, 2024 also included contributions from discontinued operations and was partially offset by distributions to noncontrolling interests in the Europe property segment and Data Centers segment.

Domino's Pizza, Inc.'s U.S. franchise advertising revenues increased primarily due to a decrease in advertising incentives related to certain brand promotions and an increase in the advertising contribution rate.
IBM's Business Transformation revenue increased 2.8 percent as reported in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the prior-year period.
The increase in Business Transformation revenue was led by finance and supply chain transformations.
IBM's Technology Consulting revenue decreased 2.5 percent as reported in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the prior-year period.
The decline in Technology Consulting revenue was partially offset by growth in application modernization services.
IBM's Application Operations revenue decreased 4.5 percent as reported in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the prior-year period.
The decline in Application Operations revenue reflected a decline in on-premise custom application management projects.

EXPAND ENERGY Corp redeemed all of the $304 million aggregate principal of the SWN 2028 Notes for approximately $312 million in a transaction during the fourth quarter of 2024, including an $8 million premium.
EXPAND ENERGY Corp repaid and terminated $389 million aggregate principal of the SWN 2025 Notes on January 23, 2025, using cash on hand and borrowings from the Credit Facility.
Arch Capital Group Ltd. completed the acquisition of Allianz’s U.S. MidCorp and Entertainment insurance businesses on August 1, 2024.
Arch Capital Group Ltd. also acquired RMIC Companies, Inc. and its subsidiaries on June 3, 2024, comprising the run-off mortgage insurance business of Old Republic International Corporation.
Quanta Services, Inc. reported net income attributable to common stock of $904,824,000 for the year ended December 31, 2024.
Quanta Services, Inc. had a weighted average of 150,056 shares outstanding for diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock in FY2024.
Quanta Services, Inc. reported adjusted diluted earnings per share of $2.94 for FY2024.
Abbott Laboratories' total net sales increased 7.4% on an organic basis during the second quarter of 2024.
Abbott Laboratories' total net sales increased 9.3% when excluding COVID testing sales during the second quarter of 2024.
PACCAR Inc estimates the U.S. and Canadian Class-8 market to be around 260,000 trucks for this year and in the range of 250,000 to 280,000 vehicles for next year.
Equity Residential spent approximately $103.8 million during 2024, primarily for unconsolidated development projects.

Equity Residential completed construction on four unconsolidated apartment properties during 2024, located in the Denver and Dallas/Ft. Worth markets, consisting of 1,262 apartment units totaling approximately $338.0 million of development costs.
Equity Residential’s total investment in two unconsolidated joint ventures was approximately $90.9 million as of December 31, 2024.
Occidental intends to repay at least $4.5 billion of debt within 12 months of closing the CrownRock Acquisition using proceeds from the divestiture program and excess cash flows.
Walmart Inc.'s gross profit rate increased 50 basis points for the three months ended July 31, 2023, compared to the same period in the previous fiscal year.

The increase in Walmart Inc.'s gross profit rate was primarily due to the lapping of higher markdowns and supply chain costs incurred in the previous year and managing prices to reflect elevated cost inflation, partially offset by product mix shifts into lower margin categories globally.

American Water Works Company, Inc. invested $518 million in the Regulated Businesses during the first three months of 2025, including $515 million for infrastructure improvements and $3 million for an acquisition that added approximately 300 customers.
The Company added approximately 4,000 new customers through organic growth in existing systems during the first three months of 2025.

As of March 31, 2025, American Water Works Company, Inc. had 18 pending acquisition agreements in the Regulated Businesses with a total aggregate purchase price of $123 million, expected to add approximately 29,000 customers.

In April 2025, American Water Works Company, Inc. completed two acquisitions of regulated water systems for $6 million, adding approximately 1,850 customers, and entered into two new agreements for $45 million to add approximately 10,200 customers.
WEC Energy Group, Inc. invested $406.1 million in its non-utility energy infrastructure business through the acquisition of Hardin III in February 2025.
Eaton Corporation plc's 2024 total employee costs were $6.5 billion, including salaries, wages, equity-based compensation, pension, and other benefits.
Eaton's median employee total compensation on October 1, 2023, was $50,683, as reported in their 2024 Proxy Statement.
EXPAND ENERGY Corp assumed approximately $3.7 billion of Southwestern’s senior notes on October 1, 2024, following the completion of the Southwestern Merger.
EXPAND ENERGY Corp’s credit rating was upgraded to ‘BBB-’ by S&P Global Ratings and Fitch Ratings on October 1, 2024, with a stable outlook.
Zebra Technologies Corporation's EVM segment Net sales increased $401 million or 13.7% in FY2024 compared to FY2023.
EVM Organic Net sales growth of 13.2% was reported, excluding foreign currency changes and acquisitions.
EVM segment Gross margin increased to 48.6% in FY2024 from 45.6% in FY2023.
EVM segment Operating income increased 55.7% in FY2024 compared to FY2023.
Zebra Technologies Corporation reported 136% free cash flow conversion for FY2024.
Zebra Technologies Corporation ended FY2024 with a 1.2x net debt to adjusted EBITDA leverage ratio.
Paychex, Inc. expects the ERTC headwind to Management Solutions growth in the fourth quarter to be similar to what it was in the third quarter.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's Embedded Processing segment revenue decreased 27% in Q3 2024 compared with Q3 2023.
Embedded Processing operating profit decreased 58% in Q3 2024 compared with Q3 2023, primarily due to lower revenue and associated gross profit.
Microsoft Corporation's Xbox content and services revenue increased 61% in FY2025 Q1 compared with the prior period, with 53 points of net impact from the Activision Blizzard acquisition.
Arch Capital Group Ltd.'s reinsurance segment's current year loss ratio for the six months ended June 30, 2024 was 2.5 points lower than in the 2023 period.
The reinsurance segment's current year loss ratio for the six months ended June 30, 2024 reflected 6.1 points of current year catastrophic activity.
The reinsurance segment's net favorable development for the 2024 second quarter was $34 million, or 1.9 points.
CarMax, Inc.'s wholesale vehicle gross profit decreased 2.9% in the second quarter of fiscal 2024.
The decrease in wholesale vehicle gross profit was primarily driven by an 11.2% decrease in wholesale unit sales.
The decrease in wholesale vehicle gross profit was partially offset by an $82 increase in wholesale vehicle gross profit per unit.
Tyson Foods, Inc.'s Prepared Foods segment reported $35 million in costs.
Tyson Foods, Inc. experienced a $27 million increase in its Chicken segment due to insurance proceeds from a production facility fire in Q4 of fiscal 2021, net of costs.
Tyson Foods, Inc. saw a $26 million increase in costs across segments due to plant closures.
News Corporation's Move segment operates Realtor.com, a premier real estate information, advertising, and services platform in the U.S.
Move's Realtor.com was affected by high U.S. interest rates that undermined market activity, though mortgage rates are beginning to moderate.
M&T Bank Corporation's income tax provision was $177 million in the first quarter of 2025.
M&T Bank Corporation's effective tax rate was 23.2% in the first quarter of 2025.
Delta Air Lines, Inc. expects to reinvest $5 billion of capital into the business in 2025, including approximately 40 aircraft deliveries and continued investment in technology and facilities.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company's Server segment experienced higher average unit prices (AUPs) contributing to a 16.3% increase in net revenue for FY2025 Q1.
The Hybrid Cloud segment contributed to the net revenue increase through higher unit volume in FY2025 Q1.

AvalonBay Communities, Inc. operates apartment communities in New England, the New York/New Jersey metro area, the Mid-Atlantic, the Pacific Northwest, and Northern and Southern California, as well as in expansion regions including Raleigh-Durham, Charlotte, Southeast Florida, Dallas, Austin, and Denver.

AvalonBay Communities, Inc. expects established coastal regions to produce rental revenue growth north of 3%, while expansion regions are projected to deliver sub-2% growth due to high unleased inventory from 2024 and new deliveries in 2025.
Moody's Corporation's Strategic and Operational Efficiency Restructuring Program is expected to result in annualized savings of $250 million to $300 million upon completion.
The restructuring program includes $170 million to $200 million of expected pre-tax personnel-related restructuring charges.
The program is expected to result in $10 million to $20 million of non-cash charges from the exit of certain leased office spaces.
The program is expected to result in $20 million to $30 million of non-cash charges related to incremental amortization of internally developed software.

Gilead Sciences, Inc. received accelerated approval from the FDA for Livdelzi for the treatment of primary biliary cholangitis in combination with ursodeoxycholic acid in adults who have had an inadequate response to UDCA, or as monotherapy in patients unable to tolerate UDCA.

Gilead Sciences, Inc. received a positive opinion from the European Medicines Agency’s Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use recommending seladelpar for the treatment of primary biliary cholangitis in combination with ursodeoxycholic acid in adults who have an inadequate response to UDCA, or as monotherapy in those unable to tolerate UDCA.

Solventum Corporation's Corporate and Unallocated expenses included one-time costs related to the Spin-Off from 3M, such as system implementations, manufacturing relocations, legal entity separations, and profit mark-ups on transition service arrangements with 3M.
Solventum Corporation's Corporate and Unallocated expenses also included sales and cost of sales related to supply agreements with 3M and other legacy 3M businesses assumed at Spin-Off.
